details: For every binary concept class, $\mathrm{RL}(\mathcal H)\geq\frac12\mathrm L(\mathcal H).
proof: A complete shattered Littlestone tree of depth d has every branch of length d, hence average branch length d. It witnesses randomized Littlestone dimension at least d/2. Take the supremum over d.
proof_source: Immediate from Definition 1 of \cite{filmus2023randomized} and the ordinary shattered-tree definition.
name: Randomized Littlestone Dimension / Littlestone Dimension
